Clip-On Extensometer Series MFA-20
 The MFA-20 Clip-On Extensometer is often used for testing of metallic materials including Rebar and specimens with scale testing due to its robust design and quick and easy change of gauge lengths.
Suitable for determining the yield point and deformation for samples above 4 mm diameter and 15 mm width. 
 Key Features
Extreme robust design
Quick and easy change of gauge lengths between 50 mm to 200 mm in steps of 5 mm
Easy to use
Class 0.5 according to ISO 9513
Adjustable clamping force
